attchmntText: TV Vision Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: TV Vision Limited has intimated a delay in submitting un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process on July 30, 2026, following an application by a financial creditor. Consequently, the Board's powers were suspended, and the Resolution Professional assumed control. The delay is attributed to the transition in management, including the verification of books of account, reconciliation of financial data, and assessment of liabilities. The Resolution Professional was scheduled to consider the results on November 14, 2026, but additional time is required for finalization. The trading window remains closed and will reopen 48 hours after the declaration of the results. The company is taking steps to submit the financials at the earliest.
